summary: CitroTech Inc. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting amendments to Stock Exchange and Stockholders Agreements originally dated May 28, 2026 with BoltRock Holdings, LLC and TC Special Investments LLC. The amendments replace each counterparty's board appointment right with a nomination right, conditioned on owning voting power equal to one divided by total directorships, plus a limited non-voting observer right. The company also furnished an investor presentation under Regulation FD. No transaction terms, stake percentages, prices, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock were disclosed. No special situation is present; this is a governance modification and routine disclosure matter.
